Email was sent to all 2026 Spotsy Disc Golf Club Membership at 7:21 pm on November 4, 2026.

Per Spotsy Disc Golf Club by-laws, we are requesting nominations for three (3) board members.  These members will serve a two (2) year term beginning on 1 January 2027.  Nominees must be in good standing with the club (meaning a 2026 member). 

·      @[100000997419950:2048:Bob Cannon], @[100000141846015:2048:Pat Mullins] and @[100000465791698:2048:Alexander Beebe] will continue to serve through 2026.
·     @[100000688673920:2048:Jake Mullins] and @[503682701:2048:Randy Newkirk] will continue to serve through 2027.  Towards the end of 2027, the club will elect two (2) board members.

·      You may nominate yourself.

·       If you nominate someone other than yourself, check with that individual to ensure they are willing to serve, prior to nominating them.

Nominations will be accepted through midnight on 28 November 2026.  Nominations may be made:

·       Via email to [spotsydiscgolfclub@gmail.com](mailto:spotsydiscgolfclub@gmail.com)

·       Facebook message to Spotsy Disc Golf Club.

·       Text or email to existing board members (Bob Cannon, Pat Mullins, Alex Beebe, Jake Mullins, Randy Newkirk).

On or about 30 November 2026, names of nominees will be sent to current club members for a vote.  Voting procedures will be announced at that time as well.

We plan to have a club meeting at the Club Championship after the stroke play round and during the Potluck Lunch.

[https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/2026_Spotsy_Club_Championship_2026](https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/2026_Spotsy_Club_Championship_2026)

We will announce the new board members at the meeting.

Let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you,

Spotsy Club Board

The **26th Shenandoah SHAG** is in the books....

PDGA and I81DGS Leaderboard have been updated --- PDGA, ODDS and PROS have been paid.

125+ players signed up for the SHAG and it was an absolute blast!

The course looked incredible, the happy and great vibe ALL weekend was palpable, mother nature blessed us with colors wherever we looked along with perfect Fall temperatures and the list of celebrities and legends, (past, current and future), is too long to list.

We introduced Shaggy' the Salamander as the new event logo and mascot.

**THANK YOU** to.........

**My Angel, Yusra**. After only a few years everyone is recognizing who the real boss is at these events and are quick to let me know. She is forever my partner, best friend and Love. Her patience and encouragement make me a better person, while her caring and tenderness keep me grounded and knowing that I have been blessed.

Billy Bob clearly let me know exactly where I rank in this hierarchy.....Before round 2, at his starting tee pad, he made a wonderful comment to us. He said, “You two are by far the nicest couple to run events”. We said “Thanks”....and then I foolishly asked “What do you mean by nice?”. He replied “Well, she is beautiful and you, well are, um, you”.

**Landon Furlong** – 30 years ago he built a course to have fun at on his property with a few friends. Soon after building the course he met me. 26 years after that, you all are witness to what has become the best place to play disc golf ever. I may be a bit biased, but I will stick to this opinion until I experience a place that brings people together in such a fashion as when we are all on his property. That will never happen.

**Landon** is and always will be the **HERO of the SHAG**. Many of you have taken time to message me with kind words about the event. Take a moment and message the person who deserves it the most -**theductor@yahoo.com - Let Landon know how much you/we appreciate him.**

@[100001235477798:2048:John Reynolds]** and **Parker Reynolds – I81DGS Crew Leader and son. They poured time and effort into preparing the course and working on getting everything ready for us all. Additionally, showing up before the sun comes up to assist with tournament central, through the day, until we clean up and leave. Their dedication is invaluable.

**Eddie Foster** – @[1621713327:2048:Maggie O'Donnell Foster] – He has been here for all 26 years and you can tell by the long scruffy beard and the fact that it is completely white. He never really gets credit for everything he does. Beyond parking the cars, Eddie helps with anything and everything he may be asked to do and often does things without even being asked in the first place. Eddie is a huge part of the heart and soul of this event and many others.

@[100000255924319:2048:Joseph Eutsler] – He bought us lunch on Saturday. Seems small right? Nope. He has done this so many times I have lost count. It is more the fact he is looking out for us, knowing we are busy with the event, on his own accord. He is a great friend to Yusra and I.

The event itself was great. I, honestly, cannot put into words the amazing feeling of togetherness and positive energy that is the aura of this place. Ask those who have experienced it and if you have not, come join us next year.

**As always – It has been my honor to be your TD and I hope everyone had a good time at the event.**

Love you all.
